description: This file defines an abstract class 'CodeRenderer' within a namespace related to Markdown content types for Confluence formatting. It provides methods for escaping CDATA sections and generating HTML elements for code blocks, possibly for rendering code snippets in Confluence.

classes.name: CodeRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class implementing NodeRendererInterface, providing methods to render code blocks with proper CDATA escaping and wrapping inside Confluence macro HTML elements.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Escapes CDATA closing sequence within code content to prevent XML parsing errors.

methods.name: getHTMLElement
methods.description: Creates an HTML structure representing a code block macro with optional language parameter for Confluence.
